A '''hypo-syringe''', also known as a '''hypo''' or '''syringe''', was a medical instrument used to inject various fluids into the body of an individual. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Akanseh]] was forced to use a hypo-syringe to chemically torture a resistance fighter while he was a prisoner of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]].
